newsitem.title: USA: Uni-Marts sees sharply lower Q4.
newsitem.headline: Uni-Marts sees sharply lower Q4.

text.p: Convenience store chain Uni-Marts Inc said on Monday it expects fourth quarter and year end earnings for the period ended September 30, 1996 to be below year ago results because of higher wholesale gasoline prices and increased competition to retain market share.
Preliminary results are expected to reflect an 80 percent to 90 percent decrease from fourth quarter fiscal 1995 results of $1.46 million, or $0.23 a share, Uni-Marts said.
Uni-Marts said it expects fiscal year profits to be 25 percent to 35 percent below last year's $4.15 million, or $0.66 a share.
Fourth quarter revenues last year totaled $89.0 million and $327 million in the prior fiscal year, the company said.
Fourth quarter and fiscal year ended September 30, 1996, revenues are expected to be $84.3 million and $333.9 million, respectively, the company said.
The company is using new merchandising intitiatives and is seeking to improve existing locations, Uni-Marts said.
